entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: ¶My son, keep my sayings, and let my rules be stored up with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:2
segments: Keep my rules and you will have life; let my teaching be to you as the light of your eyes;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:3
segments: Let them be fixed to your fingers, and recorded in your heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:4
segments: Say to wisdom, You are my sister; let knowledge be named your special friend:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:5
segments: So that they may keep you from the strange woman, even from her whose words are smooth.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:6
segments: ¶Looking out from my house, and watching through the window,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:7
segments: I saw among the young men one without sense,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:8
segments: Walking in the street near the turn of her road, going on the way to her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:9
segments: At nightfall, in the evening of the day, in the black dark of the night.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:10
segments: And the woman came out to him, in the dress of a loose woman, with a designing heart;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:11
segments: She is full of noise and uncontrolled; her feet keep not in her house.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:12
segments: Now she is in the street, now in the open spaces, waiting at every turning of the road.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:13
segments: So she took him by his hand, kissing him, and without a sign of shame she said to him:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: I have a feast of peace-offerings, for today my oaths have been effected.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:15
segments: So I came out in the hope of meeting you, looking for you with care, and now I have you.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:16
segments: My bed is covered with cushions of needlework, with coloured cloths of the cotton thread of Egypt;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:17
segments: I have made my bed sweet with perfumes and spices.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:18
segments: Come, let us take our pleasure in love till the morning, having joy in love's delights.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:19
segments: For the master of the house is away on a long journey:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:20
segments: He has taken a bag of money with him; he is coming back at the full moon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:21
segments: With her fair words she overcame him, forcing him with her smooth lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:22
segments: The simple man goes after her, like an ox going to its death, like a roe pulled by a cord;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:23
segments: Like a bird falling into a net; with no thought that his life is in danger, till an arrow goes into his side.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:24
segments: ¶So now, my sons, give ear to me; give attention to the sayings of my mouth;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:25
segments: Let not your heart be turned to her ways, do not go wandering in her footsteps.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: For those wounded and made low by her are great in number; and all those who have come to their death through her are a great army.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:27
segments: Her house is the way to the underworld, going down to the rooms of death.
